assessment: Operating ticketed municipal observation deck inside the Palacio de Cibeles tower. Its access, entry slots and prices are distinct from entry to the wider palace and CentroCentro.

observations.regularHours: Tuesday–Sunday 10:30–14:00 and 16:00–19:30, 30-minute admission slots; Monday closed.
observations.access: Final approach from floor 6E has 88 steps; lift priority for visitors with mobility difficulty.
observations.weather: Weather and safety may change access.
observations.sourceChecked: Official tourism page last updated 28 Sep 2026 and directly fetched 27 Nov 2026.
